dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped rings along the dorsal ridge characterized by sharp-edged, high-intensity perimeters with a dark interior gradient. The rings exhibit a distinct circularity with clear separation between the lighter boundary pixels and the dark core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of asymmetrical, solid-intensity light clusters observed on the lateral-ventral transition. These clusters lack a central gradient and appear as irregular, high-contrast patches against the dark pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated, slightly curved chain. Connecting the centroids of these rings to the primary mid-lateral blobs creates a series of interlocking irregular triangles.
